summary: Tested RFQ→Order conversion packaging & logistics charges fix (v63). The fix in place_order_from_quote correctly calculates: total_logistics = max(3% of subtotal, ₹3000), packaging = qty × ₹1, logistics_only = total_logistics - packaging. All edge cases verified via direct endpoint testing.
